business_summary: NetApp, Inc. develops enterprise software, systems, and services to transform data infrastructures in the United States, Canada, Latin America, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and the Asia Pacific. It operates through two segments, Hybrid Cloud and Public Cloud. The company offers data management software, such as NetApp ONTAP, ONTAP One, NetApp Snapshot, NetApp SnapCenter Backup Management, NetApp SnapMirror Data Replication, and NetApp SnapLock Data Compliance; and storage infrastructure solutions, including NetApp AFF and ASA A-Series and C-Series, NetApp AFX, NetApp Fabric Attached Storage (FAS), NetApp E/EF series, and NetApp StorageGRID. It also provides cloud storage services comprising Azure NetApp Files, Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP, and Google Cloud NetApp Volumes, as well as NetApp Cloud Volumes ONTAP. In addition, the company offers operational services, such as NetApp Data Infrastructure Insights and Instaclustr; and professional and support services include storage-as-a-service (STaaS), strategic consulting, professional, managed, and support services, as well as assessment, design, implementation, migration, and proactive support services to optimize the performance and efficiency of their on-premises and hybrid multicloud storage environments. Further, it offers ransomware protection, data backup and recovery, and disaster recovery. It serves various industries comprising energy, financial services, government, technology, internet, life sciences, healthcare services, manufacturing, media, entertainment, animation, video postproduction, and telecommunications through a direct sales force and an ecosystem of partners, including the cloud providers. The company has a strategic alliance with Commvault Systems, Inc. to develop an integrated solution for enterprise data protection and cyber resilience; and Super Micro Computer, Inc. to build integrated AI infrastructure solutions. NetApp, Inc. was incorporated in 1992 and is based in San Jose, California.
business_summary_ko: NetApp, Inc.는 미국, 캐나다, 라틴 아메리카, 유럽, 중동, 아프리카 및 아시아 태평양 지역의 데이터 인프라를 변화시키는 엔터프라이즈 소프트웨어, 시스템 및 서비스를 개발합니다. 하이브리드 클라우드와 퍼블릭 클라우드라는 두 가지 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 이 회사는 NetApp ONTAP, ONTAP One, NetApp Snapshot, NetApp SnapCenter 백업 관리, NetApp SnapMirror 데이터 복제 및 NetApp SnapLock 데이터 규정 준수와 같은 데이터 관리 소프트웨어를 제공합니다. NetApp AFF, ASA A-시리즈, C-시리즈, NetApp AFX, NetApp FAS(Fabric Attached Storage), NetApp E/EF 시리즈, NetApp StorageGRID를 포함한 스토리지 인프라 솔루션입니다. 또한 Azure NetApp Files, Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP, Google Cloud NetApp Volumes 및 NetApp Cloud Volumes ONTAP으로 구성된 클라우드 스토리지 서비스도 제공합니다. 또한 회사는 NetApp Data Infrastructure Insights 및 Instaclustr과 같은 운영 서비스를 제공합니다. 전문 및 지원 서비스에는 STaaS(Storage-as-a-Service), 전략적 컨설팅, 전문, 관리 및 지원 서비스는 물론 성능 최적화를 위한 평가, 설계, 구현, 마이그레이션 및 사전 지원 서비스가 포함됩니다.
